description: This file defines the 'WiFiServiceDiscoveryActivity' class, which manages Wi-Fi Peer-to-Peer (P2P) service discovery, connection setup, and chat interactions in an Android application supporting Wi-Fi Direct.

classes.name: WiFiServiceDiscoveryActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing Wi-Fi P2P service discovery, connection, and chat interface in the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, checks permissions, and starts Wi-Fi P2P registration and discovery.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the broadcast receiver for Wi-Fi P2P events.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver to avoid leaks.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes Wi-Fi P2P group on activity stop.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles runtime location permission result and initiates service registration/discovery.

methods.name: initP2p
methods.description: Checks device supports Wi-Fi Direct, and initializes WifiP2pManager and channel.

methods.name: startRegistrationAndDiscovery
methods.description: Registers the device’s Wi-Fi P2P service and initiates service discovery.

methods.name: discoverService
methods.description: Sets response listeners and starts discovering nearby Wi-Fi P2P services.

methods.name: connectP2p
methods.description: Connects to a selected Wi-Fi P2P service.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from the chat, including received chat data and setting chat manager.

methods.name: onConnectionInfoAvailable
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi P2P connection info; starts socket handler depending on group owner or peer role, then initiates chat fragment.

methods.name: appendStatus
methods.description: Appends status messages to the status TextView.
